title: SE ADR Schema
description: Architecture Decision Record schema for the SE cascade (Issue #339 B1). MADR-minimal with lifecycle status and REQ linking. File convention: ADR-NNN_kurztitel.md under the SE base directory.

adr_id.description: Unique ADR ID (e.g., ADR-001). Three digits, monotonically increasing, never reused.

title.description: Short title of the decision. Lowercase snake_case in the filename (kurztitel).

status.description: Lifecycle status: proposed -> review -> accepted | deprecated | superseded.

deciders.description: Agents/roles that made the decision (e.g., se-architect, user).

affected_reqs.description: REQ-IDs affected by this decision. Every ADR references at least one REQ; mirrored by open_adrs on the REQ side.

superseded_by.description: Successor ADR ID. Required when status is superseded, null otherwise.

context.description: Body section '## Kontext': problem, constraints, drivers. Problem statement, never a solution.

alternatives.description: Body section '## Alternativen': at least two options with trade-off assessment, including rejected ones.

assessment.description: Trade-off assessment; mark the rejected ones.

decision.description: Body section '## Entscheidung': the chosen solution, precise and verifiable.

consequences.description: Body section '## Konsequenzen': positive AND negative consequences.
